x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, issue #1418 (participation-citizen-advisory-vote-on-motions, REQ-CAV-001 to REQ-CAV-003). A clerk could set citizenVotingAllowed on a motion, but nothing let a resident vote. The motion now carries whether its advisory vote is open, and the counts the griffie reads once it closes. Residents vote through decidiq's portal contribution (castMotionAdvice); PortalCreateOpenParentGuardListener refuses a vote on a motion whose advisory vote is not open, a second vote by the same resident and any value other than voor, tegen or onthoud.

citizenVotingStatus.title: Advisory vote by residents
citizenVotingStatus.description: Whether residents can give their advice on this motion right now.
citizenVotingStatus.x-notes: Set only by CitizenAdviceService::open() and close() behind POST /api/motions/{id}/citizen-advice/open and /close. Opening needs a published motion with citizenVotingAllowed and citizenVotingMethod simple. The portal action castMotionAdvice is offered, and a citizen-vote on the motion accepted, only while this is open.

citizenAdviceFor.title: Residents for
citizenAdviceFor.description: How many residents advised for the motion.
citizenAdviceFor.x-notes: Counted from citizen-vote rows with this motionId when the advisory vote closes. Never read by the statutory voting round tally.

citizenAdviceAgainst.title: Residents against
citizenAdviceAgainst.description: How many residents advised against the motion.
citizenAdviceAgainst.x-notes: Counted when the advisory vote closes, as citizenAdviceFor.

citizenAdviceAbstain.title: Residents abstaining
citizenAdviceAbstain.description: How many residents gave their advice as abstain.
citizenAdviceAbstain.x-notes: Counted when the advisory vote closes, as citizenAdviceFor.
